text: [speaking quickly but controlled] Sir, please send the fire brigade. There's smoke coming from the electric meter box outside the building, no flames though. It's near the vegetable market, Budhgaon. Please sir, someone should look into it.

[speaking quickly but controlled] Yes sir, near the Miraj Market, Miraj, Sangli. The iron box was left on and the cloth under it is burning, I pulled the plug. This happened just a minute ago. Please send someone.

[voice trembling] Sir, please send the fire brigade. The fire is in the stairwell and we can't use the stairs. We are at Flat 201, Sai Residency, Khanbhag. It started just a minute ago. Kindly send help as soon as possible.

[voice trembling] I need the fire brigade. A bike is burning and everyone is keeping back because of the petrol tank. It's happening in front of Vasantdada Industrial Estate, Madhavnagar. It happened a few minutes back. Please come fast sir.
[out of breath] Sir, the fire is on the ground floor, the only exit, and several families live above. It's at Flat 202, Rajlaxmi Apartment, Ram Nagar, Market Yard. Send someone fast, please.
[out of breath] A goods truck loaded with cotton is burning in the middle of the road. We are on Old Kupwad Road, Kupwad, Sangli. It started just a minute ago. Please sir, send help immediately!

[gasping, barely able to speak] Uh, the whole building is in flames and I can hear people screaming on the upper floors. It's near the Vitthal Mandir, Abhay Nagar. It happened just now. Someone needs to get here right now!

[hysterical, crying] I- I don't know, a boiler exploded in the factory and many workers are trapped inside the flames. We are at Jhansi Chowk on Theatre Road, Ganapati Peth. It happened around quarter of an hour ago. Oh god please hurry, PLEASE!
[a little shaky] My baby has a rash and a fever and won't feed properly. We are in Gandhi Nagar, Vishrambag, Sangli. Thank you, please come.

[a little shaky] Um, a labourer got something in his eye and it's red and watering, he can't open it. We are next to the vegetable market, Vishrambag. This happened about two minutes ago. Please hurry.

[anxious, talking fast] At House number 76, Bamnoli. I need an ambulance. A man cut his leg on a sheet of metal and it's bleeding a lot, but he's awake and talking. It happened about ten minutes ago. Kindly send help as soon as possible.

[anxious, talking fast] Okay, my husband has severe chest pain and the pain is going to his left arm. We are in front of Maruti Mandir, Gaon Bhag. It started around quarter of an hour ago. Please come fast sir.

[panicked] Listen, my wife is having a miscarriage with heavy bleeding and is in terrible pain. It's at Flat 502, Shivam Apartment, Ankali. It happened just a minute ago. Please sir, send help immediately!

[panicked] My brother took too many tablets and is barely responding, it was an overdose. It's next to Sangameshwar Temple, Haripur. This happened maybe five minutes back. Please sir, send help immediately!

[sobbing uncontrollably] My wife has fainted with a lot of blood while delivering and the baby isn't crying. A few people have gathered around. We are at House number 9, Indira Nagar, Patrakar Nagar. This happened a couple of minutes ago. Hurry up, it's getting worse every second!

[sobbing uncontrollably] Please, we need a doctor... please, he is having a seizure that just won't stop and now he has gone blue. My phone battery is very low. We are behind the ESIS Hospital Kupwad, Kupwad, Sangli. It happened a couple of minutes ago. Please sir, send help immediately!

[calm but worried] On Ankali Road, Ankali. I want to report an accident. A tyre burst and the car hit the footpath, everyone is out and safe. This happened about two minutes ago. Please sir, someone should look into it.

[speaking quickly but controlled] Yes sir, near the petrol pump, Madhavnagar. A tractor trolley scraped a wall in the narrow lane and the wall has a crack, nobody is injured. The road is very narrow here. This happened about two minutes ago. Please send someone quickly.

[voice trembling] Please send help, there's been an accident. A rickshaw hit a divider and two women inside can't walk. Vehicles keep coming from both sides. It's on Vasant Park Road, Market Yard. This happened about ten minutes ago. Please sir, send help.
[voice trembling] Um, a tractor overturned on the side of the road and the driver's leg is trapped but he's talking. We are near the petrol pump, Haripur. Kindly send help.

[out of breath] Opposite the petrol pump, Khanbhag, Sangli. There's been an accident. A van full of labourers overturned and many workers are shouting in pain. It happened about ten minutes ago. Hurry up, it's getting worse every second!

[sobbing] Please send help, there's been an accident. A bike and a car collided and the biker isn't moving, there's blood coming from his head. It's happening on 100 Feet Road, Miraj. This happened maybe five minutes back. Please come quickly sir.
[hysterical, crying] At Jhansi Chowk on Theatre Road, Ganapati Peth, Sangli. A jeep collided with a bus and six people are trapped, some are not breathing. Oh god please hurry, PLEASE!

[gasping, barely able to speak] On the Sangli-Ashta Road near Budhgaon. A car rammed a bus shelter and several people are pinned under it and screaming. It happened around quarter of an hour ago. Someone needs to get here right now!

[calm but worried] Okay, my tenant is refusing to leave and is threatening me when I ask for the keys. A few people have gathered around. We are at House number 67, Gaon Bhag. It's been like this since yesterday evening. Please come as soon as possible.
[a little shaky] My wallet was pickpocketed in the crowd, I didn't see who did it. It's opposite Shastri Chowk on Harbhat Road, Gaon Bhag. It happened about two minutes ago. Please come quickly sir.

[distressed] Listen, a man is extorting money from shopkeepers and slapping those who refuse. It's happening at Garpir Chowk on District Hospital Road, Patrakar Nagar, Sangli. It started a few minutes back. Please come as soon as possible.
[distressed] Yes sir, in Bamnoli. My husband is drunk and hitting my son, please come quickly. Please send someone.
[shouting over noise] Listen, a man with a blade is slashing vehicle tyres and charging at anyone who comes close. We are at the temple, Abhay Nagar. It started just a minute ago. Kindly send help.

[sobbing] In Siddhivinayak Nagar, Vishrambag. I want to report a crime. A man is beating an old woman in the house and won't stop, we can hear her crying. I'll stay on the line. It happened about two minutes ago. Please hurry.
[screaming] At the main bus stop, Miraj. A man is slashing people with a sword in the crowd and three people are down. It happened about two minutes ago. Come quickly, there's no time, no time!

[gasping, barely able to speak] Sir, please send police quickly. She's been stabbed by her husband and she's collapsing, he is still in the house. It's in Madhavnagar. It started just a minute ago. Please send someone.
